name: tclaude-setup
description: Guide an operator through setting up tclaude itself: groups for their repos (default directory, startup context, default spawn profile, owners), spawn profiles, sandbox profiles, and schedules — inspecting first, proposing one concrete plan, getting a single time-bounded permission grant for it, then executing and verifying. Use when acting as the companion Steward (or any helper agent) asked to "set up my repos / groups / profiles / sandbox", to review an existing setup, or to explain what a setup step needs. Process templates and group templates have their own skills (process-templates, agent-circles).

findings.excerpt: tclaude agent sudo request groups.create groups.settings.default-dir \
tclaude agent groups ls                    # groups, members, default profile
tclaude agent profiles show <existing> --json > /tmp/profile.json   # start from a known-good shape
